doubts.title: How does Time Complexity analysis work for Nested Loops with Step Halving (i = i / 2)?
doubts.description: I am a 1st year student struggling to calculate the Big-O for this loop. Does this run in O(n log n) or O(log n)? Please explain the math breakdown!
doubts.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms

replies.content: Great question Aarav! This actually runs in O(n) total time, not O(n log n)! Here is why: In the 1st iteration of outer loop, inner loop runs n times. In 2nd iteration, n/2 times. In 3rd, n/4 times... Sum = n + n/2 + n/4 + n/8 + ... = n * (1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + ...) which is a geometric progression converging to 2n = O(n)!
replies.codeSnippet:
// Geometric series summation:
// Total steps = n ( 1 / (1 - 1/2) ) = 2n = O(n)

doubts.title: Difference between Process vs Thread memory space in Operating Systems exam
doubts.description: Can someone provide a clean diagrammatic explanation of what is shared between threads in the same process vs independent processes for tomorrow's mid-term?
doubts.subject: Operating Systems

replies.content: Threads within the same process share: 1. Code section (Text), 2. Data section (Global variables), 3. OS Resources (Open files, signals). BUT each thread gets its own private: 1. Program Counter (PC), 2. CPU Register state, 3. Private Call Stack! Processes on the other hand have completely isolated virtual address spaces.
